mapper.select: select f.id as id, f.goods_id as goodsId, g.title as title, g.description as description, g.price as price, g.cover_img as coverImg, g.status as goodsStatus, f.create_time as createTime from favorites f join goods g on f.goods_id = g.id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc
